lodar_1.m: Maybe over there... Yikes! Who are you!?

lodar_11.m: No ... hmm, wait. You! Maybe you can be of use here, if you are willing to help?
r: I'm up for it! What do you need help with?
I'm not so sure about this. What do you need done?
No way. You solve your own problems, old man.

lodar_12.m:
[Lodar hands you an odd looking stone that seems to be glowing from within]
Good. Take this stone, it will allow you to enter the tomb. Go below. Return once you're done.
r: You're not very good at giving directions, old man. I'll try to do what you ask.
Below? Below what? Which tomb? What are you even talking about?

lodar_13b.m: Good. Now, hurry, before the Hira'zinn moves again!

lodar_14.m: I thought I make it very clear before. With the stone in your possession, you will be able to enter the tomb. Go below. Return once you're done.
r: Fine. I still don't understand, but I'll try to do as you ask.
Oh, that makes it much clearer! I'll be right back.
OK. I'll be back once I'm done with your task.

lodar_2.m: Well, it doesn't matter who you are anyway. I am Lodar, maker of potions.
r: I was sent to find you, I'm looking for my brother, Andor - have you seen him?

lodar_2a.m: Don't know. What difference does it make? I must get all this done before the Hira'zinn moves.

lodar_3.m: Yes yes, the Hira'zinn. As I said, I must find the correct mixture before it moves again.

lodar_4.m: Now, where were they? Over here perhaps?

lodar_5.m: No, maybe I should add some of the...
r: Is there anything I can do to help?
What's going on here, why are you in such a hurry?

lodar_6a.m: Oh yes. Can you please move a bit, you are in the way. Can't you see I'm busy with finding a way to stop the spread of the Hira'zinn here?
r: You are still not making any sense to me. What is this Hira'zinn that you keep mentioning?
Very well, I'll leave you to it. Good luck.

lodar_6b.m: Didn't I tell you? I must find the correct mixture before the Hira'zinn spreads further.
r: You are still not making any sense to me. What is this Hira'zinn that you keep mentioning?
OK then. I'll leave you to it. Good luck.

lodar_7.m: Everything was fine up until a few days ago. That's when everything started to happen.

lodar_8.m: It never used to be like this, or did it? I can't remember.

lodar_9.m: Doesn't matter. I must make it stop anyway.

lodar_andor0.m: Oh, you must be referring to that older boy that was here recently.
r: You've seen him? Andor has been here?

lodar_andor1.m: He did not tell me his name, but he had some similarities to how you look. Yes, then he probably was the person you are looking for.

lodar_andor10.m: So, he asked for a sample of Narwood extract. Normally, I wouldn't give that out to just anyone.

lodar_andor11.m: However, as I said, there was something odd about this whole meeting. I actually felt a bit threatened, even though he was so polite and friendly.

lodar_andor12.m: Fearing something would happen to me if I rejected his request, I reluctantly gave him a small sample of the Narwood extract.

lodar_andor13.m: He gladly accepted the sample, and left shortly after. That's when it started to get even more odd.

lodar_andor14.m: As he left, I happened to glance out the window. There, in the forest I saw the bright flash of the light from the sun hitting a blade.

lodar_andor15.m: If I hadn't seen that light coming off the blade, I would not have spotted the person there at all. He seemed to be hiding in the forest.
r: Someone was hiding in the forest?

lodar_andor16.m: Yes, so it would seem. It was quite obvious that he did not want me to spot him. After your brother left, I saw them both speak some words to each other, before they both left together.
r: So, Andor was here, wanted some Narwood extract, and he was travelling with someone that did not want you to spot him?

lodar_andor17.m: Yes, that's basically it. But that's not all.

lodar_andor18.m: Shortly after they left, strange things started happening in the forest.

lodar_andor19.m: I saw a pack of wolves that were fighting each other. Tearing up each others sides, and eating the remains.

lodar_andor2.m: You say his name is Andor? That's an odd name, don't you think?

lodar_andor20.m: I saw birds flying over my cabin, totally covered in red blood. Blood covered birds - now that's something that I have not even heard about.

lodar_andor21.m: I tell you, something affected the forest. Myself, I felt my stomach turning even more often than it usually does.

lodar_andor22.m: I had this strong urge to eat more than usual. I even found myself having lapses of time where I could not remember what I had done for the past couple of hours.
r: What could have been causing that?

lodar_andor23.m: In hindsight, I think it's pretty clear what started to happen. The Hira'zinn awoke. To make matters worse, at least for me, it awoke in the tomb beneath my cabin here.

lodar_andor24.m: What I find disturbing is that this all started to happen right after your brother and that other person were here.

lodar_andor25.m: Maybe they visited that tomb. Now, I'm not pointing any fingers here, but it certainly seems like they had something to do with this, considering that the tomb has been quiet for ages.
r: Are you implying that Andor awoke the Hira'zinn?
I don't think I like where you're going with this. Andor is my brother, and he would never do such a thing.

lodar_andor25a.m: I don't know the details of course, and I have no proof. I only know that asking for Narwood extract is an odd request, and that the Hira'zinn started to creep up on me shortly after that.

lodar_andor26.m: Now, I am no expert in these things. I have only read bits and pieces from old books. I mostly focus my thoughts on herbs, mixtures and potions.

lodar_andor27.m: But I do know other people that might be able to provide you with further guidance.

lodar_andor28.m: Since you defeated the Hira'zinn, I think those people would be more than happy to speak to you. I would be happy to help you in any way I can too, of course.
r: Who do you have in mind?

lodar_andor29.m: Seek out Lady Lydalon in the Valanyr temple of the Shadow in Nor City. She is one of the wisest people I know, and an excellent mentor.

lodar_andor3.m: Anyway, enough of that. What would you like to know?

lodar_andor31.m: Present the letter to the guards at the temple, and they will grant you an audience with Lady Lydalon.

lodar_andor32.m: Also, while you're there, please give her my warmest regards. It has been too long since I last visited her.
r: I will go to Nor City and visit Lady Lydalon in the Valanyr temple of the Shadow.
He he, a temple. That must mean a lot of riches in there.

lodar_andor34.m: The person that was hiding among the trees here, that your brother was travelling with - I happened to get a quick view of his cloak.

lodar_andor35.m: I've seen cloaks like that before. The fabric is similar to a fabric commonly used in Nor City.

lodar_andor36.m: It could mean that whatever group of people he belongs to - there might be more of them in Nor City. Either you might want to stay away from them, or seek them out. You decide.
r: Thank you for all the information. I will travel to Nor City.

lodar_andor37.m: You have done a great deed here. Goodbye. Take care, my friend.

lodar_andor4.m: Well, even from the first time I saw him, I knew something odd was going on.

lodar_andor5.m: He seemed overly friendly to me, almost like he seemed to know me already.

lodar_andor6.m: You should know that most people that stumble into my cabin here have either been lost in the maze some time, or are just happy to see another living being.

lodar_andor7.m: He showed no such signs. Almost like he knew who I was and that he expected me to be here.

lodar_andor8.m: He very kindly asked for some Narwood extract.
r: I recognize that name 'Narwood extract' from somewhere.

lodar_andor9.m: It can be used to make quite a nasty poison.
r: Oh right. I've visited a village whose town well had been poisoned with that.

lodar_andor9a.m: Those poor poor people. They have my sympathies. I hope it's not my things that brought this misery upon them.
r: Please continue your story about Andor.

lodar_d1.m: Again, thank you for your help.
r: I'd like to talk about your potions.
What are you doing all by yourself out here in the forest?
On the body of the Hira'zinn, I found this peculiar sword. Do you know anything about it?
I have come to find you. I am looking for my brother Andor.
The way to come here is a real maze and the path is tricky to find. I think I've lost my way a hundred times. Do you know of an easier way?
I found the cave you mentioned but unfortunately the path doesn't go anywhere. I noticed a weird torch burning with a purple glow though. Do you know anything about this?
I found a cave beneath the Hira'zinn tomb but unfortunately the path doesn't go anywhere. I noticed a weird torch burning with a purple glow though. Do you know anything about this?
It worked and I didn't get injured at all! There's now a path from the Duleian road to here that lets me avoid the maze.

lodar_find0.m: Oh, it's you again. Were you successful in what I asked of you?
r: What was I supposed to do again?
I have defeated the Hira'zinn in the tomb below. Here is its heart.

lodar_find1.m: Give me that. Oh, yes ... yes!

lodar_find10b.m: Do not forget that you also saved yourself from the Hira'zinn by defeating it. Had you not done that, it would have crept up on you as well, sooner or later.

lodar_find11.m: I can assure you that my mixtures are ... well ... shall we say ... not for the faint of heart. They can have quite a profound effect on you.

lodar_find2.m: Did you really defeat the Hira'zinn? It is a formidable foe. I guess you must have, since you gave me its heart.

lodar_find3.m: What was I doing? I was searching for something. I seem to recall you being here before, is that right?
r: Yes, we spoke before, but you seemed to be obsessed with the Hira'zinn and did not make much sense.
Yes, but you were acting all crazy. I nearly put my sword through your throat.

lodar_find4.m: Well, I feel much better now.

lodar_find5.m: Thank you my friend for saving not only me but all of us.

lodar_find6.m: The Hira'zinn would have slowly but surely found a way to creep up on us all.

lodar_find7.m: So, thank you. I am in your debt. Now, how could I repay you?

lodar_find8.m: Maybe you would be interested in purchasing some of my brews, mixtures or herbal salts? I am afraid that is the only thing of any worth that I possess. I will of course offer you a discount.
r: That will do nicely. Thank you.
I killed that foul thing and saved us all, and all I get in return is a few lousy potions?

lodar_forest0.m: I try to keep to myself. Not many people find their way to my cabin here.

lodar_forest1.m: I like that. That way, I am not bothered, like I used to be.

lodar_forest2.m: Oh yes, I too grew up in the city. But that life is behind me.

lodar_forest3.m: Right now, this suits me well. I hope there won't be any more ... disturbances, like the one you helped with.

lodar_hira0.m: Ah yes, the Hira'zinn. It nearly had me fully in its grasp as well.
r: You seem a bit crazy to me.

lodar_hira1.m: That's the effect of the Hira'zinn. Its desire is to consume the minds of all it finds.

lodar_hira10.m: Could that be how the Hira'zinn extends its reach?

lodar_hira11.m: Yes, that would explain a great deal. The tales speak of it slowly creeping up on the world.

lodar_hira12.m: It could be that those formations are the way it gets closer to the people and things that it wants to consume.

lodar_hira13.m: It could be that the Hira'zinn has some way of affecting the life of the forest itself, causing these formations to appear.

lodar_hira14.m: That's what I think, at least.
r: You still sound a bit crazy to me.

lodar_hira2.m: I have only heard of it through tales in books. It has been many generations ago since it last showed itself.

lodar_hira3.m: Last time it crept up on the world, it got its grip on whole villages, I've read. People were fighting their own brethren, after having been consumed by the Hira'zinn.

lodar_hira4.m: Imagine, sisters and brothers fighting, husbands and wives going at each others throats, all because the Hira'zinn had twisted their minds.
r: Let's go back to the other questions.
What caused it to appear the last time?
Hah, those people seem like weaklings. That thing was no match for me, I could have defeated it while blindfolded even.

lodar_hira4b.m: Now, don't be so quick to underestimate the Hira'zinn. It has many tricks up its sleeve.
r: Let's go back to the other questions.
What caused it to appear the last time?

lodar_hira5.m: I do not know. The tales I have read do not tell how or why it all started - only that there was some kind of conflict going on at that time.

lodar_hira6.m: The wise men during those days also spoke of having seen some sort of signs before things got worse.

lodar_hira7.m: I don't know. Something about some rocks turning to life. Sounds like crazy-talk to me.
r: Yes, maybe they too were affected by the Hira'zinn?
I saw some odd looking rock formations on my way here through the forest. Some of them even seemed to have some inner glow in them.

lodar_hira8.m: Anyway, it's good that you defeated that thing.

lodar_hira9.m: Formations of rocks you say? Hmm. I don't recall seeing any of that the last time I ventured out.

lodar_pots1.m: Oh yes. These are the ones I have available right now. If you want, I can also create some other special potions for you.
r: Let me see the ones you have.

lodar_pots2.m: Yes, yes. I have some even more interesting recipes that I might be able to mix for you. However, I am all out of some of the most important ingredients for them.

lodar_pots3.m: If you want me to mix them for you, you'll have to help me get those ingredients.

lodar_pots4.m: Yes, were you able to get some of that Spotted Hornbeam fungus from the potion-maker in Fallhaven?
r: No, not yet. I'd like to see what potions you have available right now.

lodar_pots5.m: Oh yes, this will do nicely. Good, good. Thank you, my friend.

lodar_pots6.m: The Spotted Hornbeam fungus is an excellent reagent for creating potent mixtures.

lodar_pots7.m: With your help, I can now create additional potions from the remains of certain animals if you would like.

lodar_pq1.m: Actually, the most important ingredient is the one that I am out of. Most of the potent mixtures that I know of require the spores from the Spotted Hornbeam fungus.

lodar_pq2.m: And that, my friend, is not easy to come by here in the forest. Believe me, I have scoured the nearby forest in search for it, and I have even tried to cultivate some of it myself, to no avail.

lodar_pq3.m: However, I can imagine that the merchants in the larger settlements might have some.
r: Do you want me to find you some of that fungus?

lodar_pq4.m: Yes please. Maybe the potion-maker in that Fall-something town has some? Fall ... brim? Fall ... port?
r: Fallhaven? The potion maker in Fallhaven?

lodar_pq5.m: Yes, that's what I was looking for. Fallhaven. Go visit him and ask him if he has some. I am sure he has some, if you know enough to ask.

lodar_r0.m: Oh, it's you again. Now, who were you again?

lodar_rest.m: Sure feel free to use any bed in the main hall you like.

lodar_shortcut_0.m: Hmm, I remember seeing a cave under the former cave of the Hira'zinn. I don't know where it leads to but maybe you could give it a try and search for a shortcut through this cave?
r: Thanks for your advice! I'll check it out!

lodar_spo0.m: With the Spotted Hornbeam fungus that you brought, I can either do a mixture that makes you think you're stronger than you actually are, or a mixture that makes you resist attacks more. There's also the skin-hardening potion, of course.
r: I'd like to see what regular potions you have available.
Never mind that, let's go back to the other things we were discussing.

lodar_spo1_0.m: Have you ever noticed how insects are able to lift things that are much larger than themselves? As it turns out, I have discovered that if you mix some ground up insect wings together with the dried body of a spider, you can experience that same sensation yourself.
r: I'll go find some of that. Let's talk about the other potions.
I have those things on me, here.
I have enough of those things on me for five potions, here.
I have enough of those things on me for ten potions, here.

lodar_spo1_5.m: Excellent. These will do nicely. Now, we only need to mix these with some of this ... and some of...

lodar_spo1_5x10.m: Excellent. These will do nicely. Now, we only need to mix these with some of this ... and some of...

lodar_spo1_5x5.m: Excellent. These will do nicely. Now, we only need to mix these with some of this ... and some of...

r: Thank you. About those other potions...
Thank you. About those other potions...
Thank you. About those other potions...

lodar_spo2_0.m: I have discovered that if you mix some ground up claws from a beast called the white wyrm, together with a slight sprinkle of the center of a ruby gem, it can have a most interesting effect on you. Two of those claws and one gem would do.
r: I'll go find some of that. Let's talk about the other potions.
I have those things on me, here.
I have enough of those things on me for five potions, here.
I have enough of those things on me for ten potions, here.

lodar_spo2_5.m: Excellent. These will do nicely. Now, we only need to mix these with some of this ... and some of...

lodar_spo2_5x10.m: Excellent. These will do nicely. Now, we only need to mix these with some of this ... and some of...

lodar_spo2_5x5.m: Excellent. These will do nicely. Now, we only need to mix these with some of this ... and some of...

r: Thank you. About those other potions...
Thank you. About those other potions...
Thank you. About those other potions...

lodar_spo3_0.m: Up in the north, I have heard tales of beast called the arulir. Their skin is thick as bark due to the interesting oily substance that they produce. I have learned that if you extract some of that thick oily substance, and mix it with an infectious claw from some monster, you can make a potion that makes your skin almost as tough as theirs. I will require two of those skins for it to be effective, and I believe you can find the type of claws that I require on monsters that dwell underground and in caves somewhere outside Fallhaven.
r: I'll go find some of that. Let's talk about the other potions.
I have those things on me, here.
I have enough of those things on me for five potions, here.
I have enough of those things on me for ten potions, here.

lodar_spo3_5.m: Excellent. These will do nicely. Now, we only need to mix these with some of this ... and some of...

lodar_spo3_5x10.m: Excellent. These will do nicely. Now, we only need to mix these with some of this ... and some of...

lodar_spo3_5x5.m: Excellent. These will do nicely. Now, we only need to mix these with some of this ... and some of...

r: Thank you. About those other potions...
Thank you. About those other potions...
Thank you. About those other potions...

lodar_xul0.m: No! Get that thing away from me, I want nothing to do with it. I can almost hear the cries of the many lives that that thing has taken.

lodar_xul1.m: I tell you - that thing should be destroyed.
r: I think I'll hold on to it a bit longer.

lodar_xul2.m: You should go see the smith in Vile ... haven? Vile ... fall? Argh, I'm not very good at names.

lodar_xul3.m: Vilegard - yes, that's the place. You should go see the smith there. He might be able to guide you further.

lodar_xul4.m: Anyway, It's good that you defeated the Hira'zinn. I can't imagine what could have happened if the Hira'zinn would have given that thing into the wrong hands.

shortcut_lodar_1.m: Hmm, this is interesting. I have heard of such artifacts being teleporters but have never seen one myself. Here, take this vial and pour it over the torch. We will see what happens. I should tell you that this may be very dangerous. The artifact could respond differently than I think and could even kill you.
r: Thanks, I'll try it. Danger is my specialty.
I hope it will be OK.

shortcut_lodar_2.m: Well, that's great to hear. But don't tell this to anybody else because I don't want to have some Feygard soldiers in front of my house one day.
r: Sure, this will be a secret between us.
[Lie] Sure, this will be a secret between us.

andor.1: My father Mikhail says that Andor has not been home since yesterday. I should go look for him in the village.
andor.10: Leonid tells me that he saw Andor talking to Gruil. I should go ask Gruil if he knows more.
andor.20: Gruil wants me to bring him a poison gland. Then he might talk more. He tells me that some poisonous snakes have such a gland.
andor.30: Gruil tells me that Andor was looking for someone called Umar. I should go ask his friend Gaela in Fallhaven to the east.
andor.40: I talked to Gaela in Fallhaven. He tells me to go see Bucus and ask about the Thieves' Guild.
andor.50: Bucus has allowed me to enter the hatch in the derelict house in Fallhaven. I should go talk to Umar.
andor.51: Umar in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild recognized me, but must have me confused with Andor. Apparently, Andor has been to see him.
andor.55: Umar told me that Andor went to see a potion maker called Lodar. I should search for his hideaway.
andor.61: I heard a story in Loneford, where it seemed like Andor had been in Loneford, and that he might have had something to do with the illness that the people are suffering from there. I am not sure if it actually was Andor. If it was Andor, why would he have made the people of Loneford ill?
andor.62: Andor might have gone to do some business with a rich man in Brimhaven after he left Loneford.
andor.65: It looks like Andor was involved in the destruction of the Brimhaven dam.
andor.70: I have found the potion-maker Lodar, and heard his story about Andor. Andor went to visit Lodar in his hideaway to get a sample of something called Narwood extract. Lodar happened to notice that there was someone travelling together with Andor, that hid among the trees and did not seem to want Lodar to spot him.
andor.71: Shortly after Andor and the person he was travelling with had left, strange things started to happen in the woods around Lodar's hideaway, and Lodar himself seemed to be affected by it somehow. Lodar believes that something disturbed the tomb below his cabin, and awoke the Hira'zinn.
andor.72: Since I helped Lodar defeat the Hira'zinn, he promised to help me in return. He gave me a piece of paper that should allow me to enter the Valanyr temple of the Shadow in Nor City. He told me to seek out lady Lydalon in the temple for further assistance.
andor.80: All clues so far as to where Andor went point to Nor City. I should travel to Nor City by following the Duleian road to the southeast and look for more clues there.
andor.85: Andor may have been in Stoutford.
andor.86: Andor had something to do with the demon under the church in Stoutford.
andor.90: At Castle Guynmart I learned from Steward Unkorh that some time ago Andor was also there as a guest.
andor.92: Unkorh gave me the bonemeal potion box that Andor had given him for safekeeping.
andor.100: While exploring the town of Sullengard, I so happened to stumble upon my mother and my aunt to whom I have never met. Mother has insisted that I go home so we can talk.
andor.110: After talking with mother back at home, she and I tried to brainstorm about where Andor could be. She reminded me about Andor's friend Stanwick who lives in Brightport. We agreed that going to talk to him might be the next logical thing to do.
andor.120: In the dungeons of Laeroth manor, Kotheses, the torturer, mentioned that he had taught Andor the basics of torturing.
andor.125: Vaelric confirmed that Andor visited him recently. Andor sought to learn Vaelric's skills and left quickly, clutching what he came for. His actions raise more questions about his intentions.
andor.126: In Brightport, I was finally able to meet Stanwick, but due to his hazy memory, he was not able to help me learn anything about the whereabouts of Andor.
andor.127: Regaining his peace of mind after I helped him, Stanwick said he'll tell me more about Andor, once he gathers his thoughts.
andor.128: Stanwick gave me a signet ring that I should show to his father. Jorwick, in Nor City.
andor.130: Andor was trying to find out from Seraphina about terrible monsters in the hideout near the place with the larval burrowers.
andor.131: Elysa in the Brightport's thieves guild told me that Andor has bought a map to the sewers of Feygard.
andor.132: While investigating the Brightport theft I learned from Bryma that Andor was the one who stole the important document, and brought it to her in exchange for her alchemy knowledge.
andor.140: I saw Andor in the mountains of Galmore. We were able to exchange a few words before he disappeared again.
andor.145: I met Andor on the road to Feygard, where he was buying food from Rosmara. He disappeared again.
andor.147: I met Andor on the road to Nor City, where he was buying supplies from Alynndir. He disappeared again.
andor.910: I decided to settle down on the top of Mt. Galmore. For this I needed to find a rich and discreet man to rebuild the ruins according to my wishes. Andor will now have to go and find himself.
andor.912: The construction contract for my new home was completed. I was curious to see what it would look like.
andor.914: I visited my new residence on the top of Mt. Galmore. There I would help the people of Dhayavar as a hero and protect them from villains. Or would I become a villain myself? We'll see.
andor.999: [Quest is not completable at this time.]

lodar.10: I should find a potion maker called Lodar. Umar in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild told me that I will need to know the right words to pass a guardian in order to reach Lodar's hideaway.
lodar.15: Umar told me I should go see someone called Ogam in Vilegard. Ogam can supply me with the right words to reach Lodar's hideaway.
lodar.20: I have visited Ogam in southwest Vilegard. He was talking in what seemed like riddles. I could barely make out some details when I asked about Lodar's hideaway. 'Halfway between the Shadow and the light. Rocky formations.' and the words 'Glow of the Shadow.' were among the things he said. I am not sure what they mean.
lodar.30: I have found a formation of rocks on the Duleian Road. It does not look like they were naturally placed, but rather that they are meant to symbolize something.
lodar.31: Could this be the 'rocky formation' that the old man Ogam mentioned? If that is the case, then this might be a clue as to where Andor went.
lodar.40: In the woods close to the rocky formation, I encountered a creature blocking the way into the forest.
lodar.45: By speaking the words that Ogam had mentioned, the creature moved out of the way, and almost seemed to welcome me further into the forest.
lodar.50: I encountered a guard from Feygard in the woods. He told me a tale of a madman that the guards from Feygard are searching for. The madman is wanted for a number of reasons that he would not disclose. He warned me both about the twisty mazes ahead, and about the madman. Apparently, several guards have gone missing after venturing forth, either by getting lost in the maze, or by something that the madman has done to them.
lodar.51: Before leaving, the guard warned me both about the twisty mazes ahead, and about the madman. Apparently, several guards have gone missing after venturing forth, either by getting lost in the maze, or by something that the madman has done to them.
lodar.60: I found another rocky formation that looked out of place.
lodar.71: I encountered another guard from Feygard, disoriented and lost. The things he said did not make sense.
lodar.72: I encountered another guard from Feygard, that seemed to be affected by something. He attacked me without provocation.
lodar.73: I encountered another guard from Feygard, that rambled of something that 'lurks underneath'. He attacked me without provocation.
lodar.80: I found yet another rocky formation that looked out of place.
lodar.90: In a well-hidden cave, I encountered yet another rocky formation that looked similar to the other ones that I've already seen. I must be getting close to whatever these formations lead to.
lodar.100: In the cave, I reached what looks like a tomb. I was unable to venture further into the tomb because of something that held me back.
lodar.110: After navigating through the immense twisty green maze and the damp cave, I have reached a cabin in a clearing. The cabin is occupied by the potion-maker called Lodar.

loneford.10: I heard a story about Loneford. Apparently, a lot of people have become ill there recently, and some have even died. The cause is still unknown.
loneford.11: I should investigate what could have caused the people of Loneford to become ill. To gather clues, I should ask the citizens of Loneford and the surrounding areas about what they think is the cause.
loneford.21: The guards in the Crossroads guardhouse are certain that the illness in Loneford is caused by some sabotage done by the priests or people from Nor City.
loneford.22: Some villagers in Loneford believe that the illness is caused by the guards from Feygard, in some scheme to make the people suffer even more than they already have.
loneford.23: Talion, the chapel priest in Loneford, thinks that the illness is the work of the Shadow, as punishment for Loneford's lack of devotion to the Shadow.
loneford.24: Taevinn in Loneford is certain that Sienn in the southeast barn has something to do with the illness. Apparently, Sienn keeps a pet around that has approached Taevinn in a threatening manner several times.
loneford.25: I should go see Landa in the Loneford tavern. Rumor has it that he saw something that he doesn't dare tell anyone.
loneford.30: Landa confused me with someone else at first. He apparently saw a boy doing something around the town well during the night before the illness started. He was scared to talk to me at first since he thought I looked like the boy he had seen. Could it have been Andor that he saw?
loneford.31: Also, the night after he saw the boy at the well, he saw Buceth taking samples of the water in the well. Strangely enough, Buceth has not gotten ill like the others in the village.
loneford.35: I should go question Buceth at the Loneford chapel about what he was doing at the well, and about whether he knows anything about Andor.
loneford.41: I have bribed Buceth into talking to me.
loneford.42: I have told Buceth that I am ready to follow the Shadow.
loneford.45: Buceth tells me that he is assigned by the priests in Nor City to make sure the Shadow casts its glow over Loneford. Apparently, the priests had sent a boy to do some business in Loneford, and Buceth was tasked with gathering some samples from the water well.
loneford.50: I have attacked Buceth. I should bring any evidence that Buceth has on him to Kuldan, the guard captain in the longhouse in Loneford.
loneford.54: I have given the vial that Buceth had on him to Kuldan, the guard captain in Loneford.
loneford.55: Kuldan thanked me for solving the mystery of the illness in Loneford. They will start bringing in water with help from Feygard instead of drinking from the well from now on. Kuldan also told me to visit the castle steward in Feygard if I want to help further.
loneford.60: I have promised to keep Buceth's story a secret. If Andor was indeed here, he must have had a good reason for doing what he did. Buceth also told me to visit the chapel custodian in Nor City if I want to learn more about the Shadow.

shortcut_lodar.10: I talked with Lodar about a possible shortcut to the outside world. He said I should check the cave under the former cave of the Hira'zinn.
shortcut_lodar.20: I've found the cave but the way is blocked by rocks and water. Why can't I swim?
shortcut_lodar.22: The rock formations are not the only thing that changed here. There is now a path through the water.
shortcut_lodar.26: I notice a torch burning with a strange purple hue. It's definitely a magical item. I should ask Lodar about this torch.
shortcut_lodar.30: Upon telling Lodar about the purple fire he gave me a green vial, and told me to pour it over the torch to see what happens.
shortcut_lodar.40: I poured the vial over the purple fire and then it turned green. When approaching it I was teleported into another room of the cave with more purple torches. I was able to activate them as well. Finally, I have got my shortcut and can travel to Lodar a lot faster!
shortcut_lodar.50: I told Lodar about the new shortcut. He asked me to keep it a secret.

lodar2.10: The potion-maker Lodar seems to be obsessed with something called the Hira'zinn.
lodar2.15: Apparently, it relates to something that has started to happen recently.
lodar2.20: Lodar gave me a glowing stone, that he said would allow me to enter some sort of tomb. He did not say which tomb, where the tomb is located, or how to reach it - only that it's somewhere 'below'. Below what, I wonder?
lodar2.30: In the cave leading to Lodar's Hideaway, I reached what looks like a tomb. Could this be the one Lodar was referring to?
lodar2.35: The glowing stone that Lodar gave me, crumbled to dust as I got near the tomb. However, it seems that I am now able to enter.
lodar2.40: I have encountered a foul creature inside the tomb. I assume this is the Hira'zinn that Lodar was referring to. I should kill it and then tell Lodar.
lodar2.50: I have presented the heart of the Hira'zinn to Lodar.
lodar2.51: As soon as I presented the heart of the Hira'zinn to Lodar, he seemed to snap out of his previous state of mind.
lodar2.60: Lodar thanked me for defeating the Hira'zinn. In return, he promised to help me in any way he can. He has a large selection of potent potions available for me to purchase at a discount.

lodar_pots.10: Lodar says that he can make potions from some animal remains, if I first bring him some Spotted Hornbeam fungus. Apparently, the potion-maker in Fallhaven has a stock of it, if you know enough to ask.
lodar_pots.20: I have retrieved some Spotted Hornbeam fungus from the potion-maker in Fallhaven. I should return to Lodar with it as soon as possible.
lodar_pots.30: I have given the Spotted Hornbeam fungus to Lodar.
lodar_pots.40: Lodar thanked me for bringing him the fungus. In return, he can now create his special potions for me.
lodar_pots.41: Lodar can create a defensive potion if I bring him two White wyrm claws and a Ruby gem.
lodar_pots.42: Lodar can create a potion of strength if I bring him a dead spider and the wings of an insect.
lodar_pots.43: Lodar can create a potent defensive potion if I bring him two arulir skins and a claw from some monster. The arulir beasts can be found somewhere up in the north, and the claws can apparently be found from creatures that dwell underground and in caves somewhere outside Fallhaven.

xulviir.10: I was told that the broken sword that I found on the body of the Hira'zinn should be taken to the smith in Vilegard.
xulviir.20: I have restored the Xul'viir. I had to threaten the smith in Vilegard to get it restored.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
